## Design rulings (ADR-0298)

- **One spawn path** — `hh-subagent::spawn` is the only implementation;
  the C3 orchestrator lowers every admitted stage to a `SubagentSpec` and
  passes through the same steps 1–8.
- **Deterministic replay identity** — `child_run_id` derives from
  `(decision, H(spec))`; replay adopts durable budget, ownership,
  environment, subscription and child-run effects instead of minting a
  duplicate.
- **Replayable env derivation** — `EnvDeriver::derive_for` accepts
  `derived_for = child_run_id` so a crash after derivation adopts the
  durable handle.
- **Reciprocal anchors** — the child manifest carries `parent_run_id`,
  `spawn_event`, inherited audit/envelope fields and `parent_anchor`;
  spawned/result/cancelled stamp `scope.child_run_id`; `child_head`
  prefers the signed final checkpoint.
- **No context laundering** — `SubagentResult` re-enters as refs,
  artifacts, claims, usage and provenance only; there is no transcript or
  raw model-I/O member.
- **Audited containment and merge** — `single_writer`/`parent_decides`
  emit merge audit rows, project a durable `MergeReport`, retain
  conflict/absent-child/lost-write facts, and veto unowned or
  unaccounted writes.
- **Closed topology catalogue** — T0–T7 parse as a closed set; this slice
  implements T0/T1/T2/T6 and refuses T3/T4/T5/T7 typed.
- **Matched-budget conditionality** — `lab/delegation-v1` executes real
  arms through the same spawn path and emits conditional comparison
  reports only under complete commensurable `MatchSpec`.

## Landed

- **`hh-subagent` (new crate)** — `types` (`SubagentSpec`, delegated
  authority, `ReturnContract`, `SubagentResult`, `ChildOutcome`,
  ownership/messaging/merge contracts and typed errors), `spawn` (steps
  1–8: envelope checks, spawn-process admission, delegate attenuation,
  `slice`/`pool` budget, ownership grant, env derive/share, durable
  spawned edge, deterministic child open + writer lease, parent
  subscription), `result` (`record_child_result`, `record_child_cancelled`,
  `detach_to_child`, terminal drain/cancel paths, signed-checkpoint-aware
  `child_head`, typed `ReturnContract` violations), `recovery`
  (`restore_parent` scans interrupted spawned edges, repairs missing
  subscriptions, cancels nonexistent children, drains terminals,
  revocation cascade), `ownership` (parent-owned grant validation +
  `control.ownership.transferred`), `merge` (`control.merge.*`,
  `MergeReport`, `single_writer`/`parent_decides`, conflict and lost-write
  accounting, G-1/G-2/G-5 vetoes), `messaging` (sealed `MessagingPolicy`,
  `control.message.sent`/`refused`, relay-set selection, `peer_message`
  receiver wakeups).
- **`hh-orchestrator` (new crate)** — `topology` (closed T0–T7 parse-only
  catalogue; implemented set = T0/T1/T2/T6), `orchestrator` (admission,
  topology stage validation, `delegation_reason` stamping, wait
  `{all, any, quorum(k)}`, parent-end planning, T1 fan-out, T2 staged
  pipeline, T6 detached spawn, restore + relay surfaces), `lab`
  (`lab/delegation-v1` registered with topology arms executing through
  the spawn path and conditional matched-budget report emission).
- **`hh-ledger`** — `control.subagent.{spawned,result,cancelled}` now
  opens/closes the `ChildRun` scope; `control.merge.*`,
  `control.message.*`, `control.ownership.transferred` are audit classes;
  `peer_message` is admissible as a durable wakeup occurrence;
  `open_run_with_id` supports deterministic child identity/replay; Stage-4
  kill-point names landed for the spawned path.
- **`hh-control`** — `DriverConfig.delegation_available` gate refuses a
  `delegate` decision as `delegation_unavailable` unless the capability is
  armed; `delegation_reason` is mandatory for code/model-owned delegate
  decisions; `peer_message` is admitted through trigger validation.
- **`hh-env`** — `EnvDeriver::derive_for` takes the deterministic child id
  and records `action.environment.derived.derived_for`.
- **`hh-budget`** — `Account::complete` is idempotent: a retried terminal
  child-result path cannot append a second release or subtract the slice
  remainder twice.
- **`scripts/check-removability.sh`** — now proves `hh-subagent` is
  edge-free upward and `hh-orchestrator` is its only normal consumer.
- **`Cargo.toml` / `Cargo.lock`** — new persistent workspace members with
  the S4.6 C1/C3 comments.

## Log

- 2026-09-26: implemented per plan; `hh-subagent`/`hh-orchestrator`
  created; authority, budget, ownership and environment attenuation are
  durable before child open; `open_run_with_id` and deterministic ids
  landed.
- 2026-09-26 (incident): early result paths did not stamp
  `scope.child_run_id`, leaving the checkpoint verifier without a
  cross-run producer; fixed by treating spawned as `open ChildRun` and
  result/cancelled as `close ChildRun`, then stamping the scope on all
  three emitters.
- 2026-09-26 (incident): `record_child_result` cited only the child's
  current head. DF-S2.5-2 requires the reciprocal terminal anchor, so
  `child_head` now prefers the child's signed `final` checkpoint
  (`checkpoint_ref` + covered seq/hash) and falls back to current durable
  head only where no final exists.

  inherited untouched `hh-bench/tests/s3_12b.rs:338` `never_loop` error
